caption: The drawing depicts a single, tall vase with an ornate design. The vase is rendered in shades of deep purple and violet, with lighter and darker accents highlighting its contours and giving it a glass-like appearance. The rim of the vase is scalloped and flares outward, with wave-like curves. The body of the vase is vertically elongated and gently tapers in toward the neck, showing vertical grooves or fluting. The stem is short, leading to a broad, faceted base that appears hexagonal, providing stability. The object is centrally positioned against a plain, cream-colored background with no other visible elements or objects.
title: Vase
